config.label: An OAuth refresh token you already hold
config.description: An OAuth refresh token you already hold. Supply this and no password is needed — the login is skipped entirely.

config.label: Skylight account email
config.description: Skylight account email. Pair with SKYLIGHT_PASSWORD for direct login. Needed only if you are not supplying SKYLIGHT_REFRESH_TOKEN.

config.label: Skylight account password — required iff SKYLIGHT_EMAIL is set
config.description: Skylight account password — required iff SKYLIGHT_EMAIL is set. Needed only if you are not supplying SKYLIGHT_REFRESH_TOKEN.

config.label: Optional: pick a specific Skylight frame when the account has more than one
config.description: Optional: pick a specific Skylight frame when the account has more than one.

config.label: Friendly account name used in startup logs
config.description: Friendly account name used in startup logs.

config.label: Set to false to disable the on-disk token cache and re-authenticate on every process start
config.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk token cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

config.label: Absolute path for the token cache file
config.description: Absolute path for the token cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.skylight-mcp/tokens.json.

config.label: Override the API base (default https://app
config.description: Override the API base (default https://app.ourskylight.com/api). The auth origin is derived from it, so pointing this elsewhere moves the login flow too — and the new host must be added to the registration’s egress allowlist, or every call is blocked.
